scripts.build: npm run build -w @baby-name-matcher/shared && npm run build -w @baby-name-matcher/server && npm run build -w @baby-name-matcher/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --watch apps/server/src/index.ts" "npm run dev -w @baby-name-matcher/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @baby-name-matcher/shared && npm run typecheck -w @baby-name-matcher/shared && npm run typecheck -w @baby-name-matcher/server && npm run typecheck -w @baby-name-matcher/web
